# Small testable issues

Read the approved scope and `docs/MainDocs.md`. Search existing issues before
creating duplicates. Create external issues only when the user requests it;
an explicitly authorized batch does not need another permission round.

Each issue states user value, source reference, scope, observable acceptance
criteria, at least one failure case, tests and dependencies. Separate a hardware
feasibility experiment from a feature that assumes its result. Keep work small
enough for one focused PR, with tests beside the behavior they prove.
Use existing labels and real issue numbers. Use structured tool arguments or a
body file for multiline text. Report created URLs or an honest access blocker.
